Everyone around me keeps asking, “How do I escape the Rat Race!”
How do I stop going to the office, stop working and Finally Retire by withdrawing money from my savings account!
But there is a problem!
If you keep withdrawing from the Saving Pool, one day it would just exhaust.
But there is a solution - SWP.
In this video, we try to understand what is the efficient way of using your savings and doing your SWP Smartly.
